name: Flying Bird VR: Sky Challenge
summary:
Take flight as the bird in Flying Bird VR: Sky Challenge, a fast, cheerful arcade experience built for quick VR sessions and one-more-run excitement.

Gravity is always pulling you down. Press A, B, X, Y, or either trigger to flap upward, then thread the gap between glossy green sky obstacles. Every clean pass adds a point, and the course keeps coming until one mistimed flap ends the run. Restart in seconds and try to beat the best score saved locally on your headset.

Choose First Person to become the bird
